aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:862.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! PRODUCTION STAFF STAGEHAND SUMMARY The Stagehand is responsible for performing all setup before, during, and after events which includes, but is not limited to, assembling and disassembling production equipment on stage. In addition, the Stagehand will work closely with and assist carpenters with scenery build, installation, video, sound, and light production. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for assembling and setting up at the beginning of the scene (i.e., props, microphones, musical instruments, scenery, etc.), disassembling and removing equipment at the end of the scene in addition to cleaning up the stage and backstage area after performances. Load and unload equipment from trucks and set up equipment according to stage design while ensuring safety requirements are met. Assist carpenters with scenery build and installation of stage maintenance, construct and paint set pieces, move and rearrange furniture. Work closely with electricians and lighting assistants with maintenance of video, sound, and light production. Ensure operations of systems are functioning properly. QUALIFICATIONS A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency A minimum of 1-2 years of related work experience. Previous experience with manual labor preferred. Forklift and heavy machinery certified ideal, but not required. Must be able to take direction and execute instructions accurately. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to lift, push and pull up to 50 pounds. SALARY RANGE (Depending on Position/Venue/Location/Experience) $20.00-$25.00 BONUS These positions are not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. BENEFITS Event based positions are not eligible for benefits through AEG Presents. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside his/her normal description. Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fa638f0a-8e14-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Assistant / Deputy Manager - Collection & Retention based in India. This role is responsible for driving customer retention, reducing churn, and improving overall customer profitability. You will lead teams and implement innovative strategies that strengthen customer loyalty and reduce disconnections. The position combines customer experience, collections, people leadership, analytics, and continuous process improvement. You will use customer insights, complaint trends, and performance data to identify opportunities and deliver measurable improvements. A key part of the role is building a culture of care, accountability, productivity, and high-quality service. You will also work closely with cross-functional teams and senior management to resolve escalations and improve processes. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced retention leader with strong industry knowledge and a proven record of managing large teams. Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of customer retention and collection processes. Drive gross and net churn targets by developing strategies that reduce customer disconnections and improve retention. Improve team productivity, operational efficiency, and service quality through effective performance management. Analyze customer feedback, call quality, repeat complaints, and service issues to identify root causes and recommend permanent solutions. Build and promote a culture centered on customer care, compassion, accountability, and strong performance. Ensure customer requests and concerns are addressed promptly and effectively. Coach, support, and develop team members by identifying training and capability-building needs. Explore automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention and improve operational efficiency. Build strong cross-functional relationships and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve customer and process issues. Develop and share management reports, performance analyses, presentations, and actionable customer insights. Support enterprise payment processes and oversee the recovery of doubtful or overdue customer debts. Maintain strong relationships with large and strategically important customers, including direct relationship management when required. Act as the final escalation point for complex customer issues and ensure appropriate resolution. Identify and implement process improvements that contribute to higher customer satisfaction, lower churn, and improved profitability. Requirements Graduate or postgraduate qualification from a reputed institution. Minimum 9+ years of experience in customer retention, collections, customer experience, or a related function. Relevant experience in the ISP, telecommunications, banking, or similar customer-centric industry is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of customer retention strategies, churn management, and collection processes. Proven ability to lead and manage large teams in a target-driven operational environment. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret customer, operational, and performance data and translate insights into action. Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. Strong customer relationship management capabilities, particularly when dealing with large or strategically important accounts. Ability to manage escalations calmly and develop practical, customer-focused solutions. Strong leadership, coaching, and people-development skills. Demonstrated ability to identify process inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement. Commercial awareness and an understanding of how retention and collections contribute to profitability. Highly organized, proactive, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to work 6 days per week .
